By this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioner, namely, Page No.# 2/3 Chandan Pathak, has prayed for grant of bail in connection with Paltan Bazar P.S. Case No. 97/2023 under Sections 376 of the IPC r/w Section 67 of the IT Act.
The case diary, as called for, is placed before the Court.

sentences.text: The accused petitioner has been in judicial custody since 29.09.2023, i.e. for 44 days.
The matter relates to commission of rape on the victim woman by the accused petitioner and thereby made her nude photos and videos viral in social media.
It is noticed that the victim lady, aged about 31 years, has refused to undergo medical examination.

On perusal of the case diary, including the statement recorded u/s 164 Cr.P.C., it appears that there is prima facie implicating material against the accused petitioner subject, of course, to final outcome in investigation.

However, having considered the length of detention in judicial custody, this Court is of the considered opinion that further continuation of detention of the accused in the interest of investigation is not warranted.

Accordingly, it is provided that the accused petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail of Rs.
40,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati subject to the following conditions- i) That the accused petitioner shall cooperate with the Page No.# 3/3 Investigating Officer as and when required; and ii) That the accused petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Police Officer or the Court.
This disposes of the bail application.
